For the Petitioner : Mr. Rajveer Singh, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Ruby Pandey, Addl. P.P.
------
Order No.06 Dated- 07.11.2025 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has moved this Court for grant of bail in connection with Palamau Cyber Crime P.S.
Case No.12 of 2023 and Cyber Crime Case No. 02 of 2025 registered for the offences punishable under sections 419, 420, 467, 468 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 66(C) and 66(D) of the I.T. Act, 200.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner has committed online fraud by syphoning Rs.23,90,000/- from the bank account of the informant -Dilip Kumar Das by using Any Desk App and out of the syphoned amount, an amount of Rs.4,90,000/- was credited in the bank account of the petitioner and during the course of investigation, from the back cover of the mobile phone seized, the SIM card associated with Mobile No. 7602410170 was recovered by the police, which was in the name of the petitioner.
It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false and the petitioner is not named in the F.I.R.
It is then submitted that the petitioner has no criminal antecedent as has been mentioned in para -12 of the bail application.
It is next submitted that the petitioner has been in custody since 24.12.2024, as has been mentioned in paragraph no. 01 of the bail application.
It is further submitted that the petitioner undertakes to cooperate with the trial of the case.
Hence, it is Ranjit Maity @ Ramjit Maity vs The State Of Jharkhand ...

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Opposite ... on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128650960/
1 submitted that the petitioner be admitted to bail.
The learned Addl. P.P. opposes the prayer for bail.
Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above and the period in custody undergone by the petitioner, I am inclined to enlarge the above-named petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge,
Cyber Crime, Palamau, in connection with Palamau Cyber Crime P.S. Case No.12 of 2023 and Cyber Crime Case No. 02 of 2025 with the condition that the petitioner will co-operate with the trial of the case and will furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the trial of the case.
